description: Detect execution in a virtualized environment.

option.name: --chroot
tip: Detect whether we are run in a chroot() environment.

option.name: --container
tip: Only detect whether we are run in a container.

option.name: --cvm
tip: Only detect whether we are running in a confidential VM.

option.name: --list
tip: List all known and detectable types of virtualization.

option.name: --list-cvm
tip: List all known and detectable types of confidential virtualization.

option.name: --private-users
tip: Only detect whether we are running in a user namespace.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not output anything, just set the return value.

option.name: --vm
tip: Only detect whether we are run in a VM.
